label: ACCEPT
reason: Service classes are named *Service (agent-command-publisher.service.ts, agent-memory-indexing.service.ts, prisma.service.ts); the two exempt items are error classes the rule already excepts, and eslint ignores legacy/** and has no class-naming rule, so a mis-named service class would not be caught by any tool. A team naming scheme worth flagging.

label: WRONG
reason: Source files (main.ts, DesktopNotificationService.ts, electron.vite.config.ts) never touch packaging/buddy, but the sole outlier electron-builder.config.cjs is the packaging config whose whole job is to require packaging/buddy/release/*.mjs; a new packaging-side config in apps/buddy would be warned for nothing. Hesitated with ACCEPT (layering boundary); the boundary lint rule does not cover packaging.

label: ACCEPT
reason: Preload factories are consistently createXApi (browser.ts, themes.ts, local-chat/web.ts, providers.ts); the only exempt item is the shared subscribe helper, and no lint rule enforces function naming, so a new factory off the scheme would be a naming-scheme deviation worth flagging.
